title: 第19章 星尘显威退强敌第20章 改良菜刀惊四方
slug: 签到玄天我成了万界守护者
content_zh:
方浩把最后一片玉牌灰烬倒进青铜鼎，转身就走。
地窖口的星尘还在缓缓旋转，像锅盖上的蒸汽。
他没回头，但耳朵竖着，听那石缝里渗血的声音——滴、滴、滴，慢得像是有人在用针尖蘸墨写字。
他停下。
“第二具？”
他歪头笑了一声，蹲回那滩血前，手指在沙地上划拉，“那第三具排号到哪年？要不先交定金，我给你打个折，买一送一，附赠免费搓澡服务。”
话音落，血线猛地一颤，像被无形的手抽了一鞭子。
细沙开始蠕动，血珠从石缝里争先恐后地挤出来，顺着地面爬行，勾勒出更复杂的纹路。
方浩右臂上的黑纹突然发烫，像是有人往血管里灌了熔化的铁水。
“哎哟，还带远程催债的？”
他缩了缩胳膊，从鼎底抓出一把银白色的流沙——今早签到得的“变异星尘”
，摸上去像刚从冰窖里捞出来的铁屑，凉得能冻住魂。
他没犹豫，反手就撒。
星尘落地，和血线一碰，发出“滋”
的一声，像烧红的铁杵插进油锅。
血迹瞬间汽化，黑烟腾起，烟里隐约有锁链虚影一闪而过，又迅速消散。
“还挺上相。”
方浩吹了声口哨，“下次投影记得带背景板，省得显得寒酸。”
话音未落，血线猛然收缩，凝成一只竖瞳般的血色眼睛。
眼瞳中央裂开一道缝，一道人影跨步而出。

猩红长袍，半透明面具，裂口处露出一只泛着幽光的竖瞳，直勾勾盯着方浩的右臂。
“那块皮，”
血衣尊者声音像是从生锈的铁管里挤出来的，“该换主人了。”
方浩往后一退，后背撞上青铜鼎。
鼎身轻轻一震，他还没来得及反应，掌心剩下的星尘突然自己浮了起来，像被磁石吸住，环绕周身，缓缓旋转。
“哟？”
他眨眨眼，“今儿还挺主动？”
他心念一动，默念：“系统出品，绝不坑爹。”
星尘如听号令，猛地扑向那血瞳幻影。
沙粒入血，竟不相融，反而像油泼进水，瞬间炸开。
血幕被撑得扭曲变形，七道银光从中刺出，凝成七柄悬浮的星剑，剑尖朝下，围成北斗之形。
“哦？”
血衣尊者眯眼，“有点意思。”
他抬手，掌心凝聚出一杆血矛，矛尖滴着暗红液体，一滴落地，石砖立刻腐蚀出蜂窝状的坑洞。
“你这身皮，浸了三十七年尘垢，正好补我血河阵的漏洞。”
他冷笑，“省得我再去挖坟。”
话音未落，血矛脱手而出，直取方浩眉心。
content_en:
Fang Hao poured the last piece of jade ashes into the bronze tripod, turned around and left.
The stardust at the entrance of the cellar is still spinning slowly, like steam on the lid of a pot.
He didn't look back, but he kept his ears straight, listening to the sound of blood seeping from the cracks in the stone - drip, drip, drip, as slow as someone dipping the tip of a needle in ink to write.
He stopped.
"The second one?"
He tilted his head and laughed, squatting back in front of the pool of blood, scratching his fingers on the sand, "Then what year will the third body be numbered? Why don't you pay a deposit first, and I'll give you a discount, buy one, get one free, and give you a free bathing service."
As soon as the words fell, the blood line trembled suddenly, as if being whipped by an invisible hand.
The fine sand began to squirm, and blood beads rushed out from the cracks in the stones, crawling along the ground and outlining more complex lines.
The black lines on Fang Hao's right arm suddenly became hot, as if someone poured molten iron into his veins.
"Oh, you're bringing someone with you to collect debt remotely?"
He shrunk his arm and grabbed a handful of silver-white quicksand from the bottom of the cauldron - the "mutated stardust" he signed in this morning.
, it feels like iron filings just fished out of the ice cellar, so cold it can freeze your soul.
He didn't hesitate and let go with his backhand.
The star dust fell to the ground, touched the blood line, and made a "sizzle"
There was a sound, like a red-hot iron pestle inserted into a frying pan.
The blood stains instantly vaporized, black smoke rose up, and the faint shadow of chains flashed past in the smoke, and then quickly dissipated.
"Quite photogenic."
Fang Hao whistled, "Next time you project, remember to bring a background board to avoid looking shabby."
Before he finished speaking, the blood line suddenly shrank and condensed into a blood-colored eye with a vertical pupil.
A slit opened in the center of the eye pupil, and a figure stepped out.
The scarlet robe and translucent mask revealed a glowing vertical pupil from the slit, staring directly at Fang Hao's right arm.
"That piece of skin,"
The blood-clothed venerable's voice sounded like it was squeezed out of a rusty iron pipe, "It's time to change the master."
Fang Hao stepped back and hit the bronze tripod with his back.
The tripod shook slightly, but before he had time to react, the remaining stardust in his palm suddenly floated up on its own, as if being attracted by a magnet, surrounding him and slowly rotating.
"Yo?"
He blinked, "Are you quite proactive today?"
With a thought in his mind, he muttered silently: "Produced by the system, it will never cheat you."
Xingchen heard the order and rushed towards the blood-eyed phantom.
When the sand enters the blood, it does not melt. Instead, it explodes like oil poured into water.
The blood curtain was twisted and deformed, and seven rays of silver light pierced out from it, condensing into seven suspended star swords, with the sword tips pointing downward, forming a Beidou shape.
"Oh?"
The blood-clothed venerable squinted his eyes, "It's interesting."
He raised his hand, and a blood spear condensed in his palm. The tip of the spear was dripping with dark red liquid. When a drop fell to the ground, the stone bricks immediately corroded into honeycomb-shaped holes.
"Your skin has been soaked in dirt for thirty-seven years, which is perfect for filling the holes in my Blood River Formation."
He sneered, "Save me the trouble of digging another grave."
Before he finished speaking, the blood spear came out of his hand and hit Fang Hao directly between his eyebrows.
